models_evaluated: FPAR-based AI model for humeral tumor detection

links.outcome: Radiologist sensitivity, specificity, accuracy with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: AI assistance improved radiologists' sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy by 8.9%, 1.2%, and 3.5%, respectively (P < .05 for all).
links.quote: AI assistance improved the radiologists’ sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy by 8.9%, 1.2%, and 3.5%, respectively (P < .05 for all).

unlisted_practices: False-positive activation area reduction (FPAR) training method to improve model localization and reduce false positives

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing 10 radiologists interpreting chest radiographs with versus without AI assistance.

primary.practice: AI assistance in radiologist reading workflow
